critical_code_review_comments: ClinicalHistory.jsx HistorySection: data-active-count attribute populated from items.filter(status==='ACTIVE').length — matches contract and drives the red styling with warn flag.

HistoryDrawer: Save body is Object.fromEntries(cfg.fields.map ...) so blank optional fields POST as null (expected); backend validates server-side. Edit uses PATCH with status; non-editing creates via POST.

HistoryDrawer only renders Status select in edit mode (good — new records default server-side to ACTIVE). Status options for surgeries use statusLabel map so UI shows 'Archived (entered in error)' while value sent is ARCHIVED.
PshxSection filters out ARCHIVED on right column but drawer list shows all (muted) — matches spec that no record is deleted, only hidden from the compact right-column view.
